Name: Hello Kitty Backpack - Standalone (EN ES ZH)
Author: POCHIMODS
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54337/54337-1792694417-37503527.png[/img][/center]

[b]English[/b]
A standalone Hello Kitty backpack with a red bow. Buy the design at Pierre’s or Sandy’s for 500g; press [b]F9[/b] to show or hide it. Install SMAPI and extract this download into Mods. Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and SMAPI 4.0.0+. [b]GMCM is optional[/b] for hotkeys and prices.
[b]Several backpacks?[/b] You will need the separate Backpack Wardrobe menu to prevent overlaps and choose which to wear. It will be released later. Hello Kitty alone needs no menu.

[center][img width=600,height=200]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54337/54337-1792694427-563919074.png[/img][/center]

[b]Español[/b]
Mochila Hello Kitty independiente con lazo rojo. Compra el diseño en Pierre o Sandy por 500 g; [b]F9[/b] la muestra u oculta. Instala SMAPI y extrae esta descarga en Mods. Requiere Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ y SMAPI 4.0.0+. [b]GMCM es opcional[/b] para cambiar teclas y precios.
[b]¿Varias mochilas?[/b] Necesitarás el mod del menú Backpack Wardrobe para evitar que se superpongan y escoger cuál llevar. Lo publicaremos más adelante. Para usar solo Hello Kitty no hace falta.

[center][img width=600,height=200]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54337/54337-1792694431-1179194237.png[/img][/center]

[b]简体中文[/b]
独立的 Hello Kitty 红蝴蝶结背包。在皮埃尔或桑迪商店花 500 金购买，按 [b]F9[/b] 显示或隐藏。安装 SMAPI，将此下载解压到 Mods。需要 Stardew Valley 1.6.15+、SMAPI 4.0.0+。[b]GMCM 为可选[/b]，可修改快捷键和价格。
[b]想安装多个背包？[/b]需要单独的 Backpack Wardrobe 菜单模组来避免背包重叠并选择外观。菜单稍后发布；仅使用 Hello Kitty 时无需菜单。
